Names are written as SQL needs them: a name in double quotes is case-sensitive and works only with its quotes. A view named like a `pg_catalog` relation, or like a temporary table you created, is shadowed in unqualified queries: qualify it with the schema. Only the columns listed here exist; every other column was removed on purpose. Statements time out after 15s.
